title: agent.opencode.session v1
description: opencode session lifecycle, published by agent-hooks/opencode/nervous-bus.js through `nervous publish`. One event per opencode session.created, session.idle and session.deleted. Replaces the retired ccm.session channel.

event.description: started = session.created, idle = session.idle (the agent finished a turn), ended = session.deleted.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id when this is a subagent session. Absent for top-level sessions.

title.description: Session title when opencode has set one.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC time the plugin saw the event.
